verdict.rationale: Loops treats transactional email as a distinct send type. It has a dedicated POST /transactional endpoint with data variables, positioned for receipts, password resets and login codes, and transactional sending is included on paid plans. However, it markets transactional and marketing as 'one API, one contact model,' and nothing shows separate suppression handling or reputation isolation. Missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends bypass marketing unsubscribes, separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation/IPs or streams, and documented separate transactional template management.
